01. About Me

A software engineer passionate about building robust, scalable systems. I thrive in fast-paced environments where I can solve complex problems and deliver high-quality solutions.

I graduated with a Master's in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Arlington. My thesis, done in the Cyber-Physical Systems Security Lab, evaluated how well GNN-based vulnerability detectors hold up when code is deliberately obfuscated.

Along the way I've shipped production healthcare and fintech platforms, kept Linux infrastructure running for more than 1,000 users, and built tools that sit where backend engineering, cloud infrastructure and machine learning meet.

Here are a few technologies I've been working with recently:

  • Go
  • Python
  • TypeScript & Node.js
  • React & React Native
  • Kubernetes & Docker
  • AWS & Terraform
  • PyTorch & TensorFlow
  • LangChain & LangGraph
